{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Checking premises...")
print(f"- Converted column is binary: {set(df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1}}")
print(f"- Age -1 count: {df['customer_age'].eq(-1).sum()} out of {len(df)} rows")

# Verify that 'status' == 'refunded' is not in the converted group
refunded_in_converted = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'refunded')]
print(f"- Refunded orders in converted group: {len(refunded_in_converted)}")

# Summary
print("\nData overview:")
print(df.info())

# Check for the QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"- QA orders detected: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Show first few rows of age
print("\nFirst few customer_age values:")
print(df['customer_age'].head(10))"}
